name: Identity-aware Execution
summary: Govern external Worker actions through explicit identities, managed Connections, versioned authorization policies, obligations, durable pre-effect decisions and attributable audit evidence; provider enforcement is verified per execution mode, never assumed.
next_action: Assign a human programme owner; review ADR-0475 and IAE4's supervised versus external Worker trust boundary; define the next executable slice.

slices.title: Architecture, ADR and threat model
slices.note: PR #1354 merged the initial plan; ADR-0475 remains Proposed/Partial. Review and accept trust boundaries, revocation, audit and migration gates.

slices.title: External identities and Connections
slices.note: Partial foundation; verify multiple external identity linking, connection ownership and binding, encrypted credentials, revocation and restart behavior.

slices.title: Provider authentication and token lifecycle
slices.note: Partial Microsoft supervised path; verify PKCE, token rotation, consent, restart safety and compatibility with app-only credentials.

slices.title: Policy administration and deterministic decisions
slices.note: Partial policy seam; define immutable revisions, trusted attributes, non-overridable guards, fail-closed combining and FEEL/DMN tests.

slices.title: Authorization enforcement before external effects
slices.note: Narrow supervised SharePoint example only. Prove fenced action binding, fsync-gated decisions, retries and recovery; remote Worker enforcement remains unresolved.

slices.title: Approval obligations and separation of duties
slices.note: Bind independent verified approvals to exact action parameters and expiry; no process-variable authorization shortcuts.

slices.title: Console, Operations and audit
slices.note: Deliver user identity linking, Connection and policy management, simulator, Worker bindings and accessible audited decision history.

slices.title: Additional Worker Type enforcement
slices.note: Provider-by-provider proof for Microsoft Mail, selected Entra, Google, Jira/REST; no general security claim before verified PEP.

slices.title: Controlled SharePoint PoC and readiness
slices.note: Test against an explicitly consented tenant/site with denied and approved operations; separate mocked evidence from real BIT validation.
